description: This Java test class 'CredentialsAmqpIT' verifies the behavior of the Credentials AMQP endpoint in the Eclipse Hono device registry component. It sets up and tears down test fixtures using Vert.x and JUnit 5, and tests client interactions with the registry.

classes.name: CredentialsAmqpIT
classes.description: Test class verifying the Credentials AMQP endpoint in the Eclipse Hono device registry.

methods.name: prepareDeviceRegistry
methods.description: Initializes the device registry, sets up the client connection before all tests.

methods.name: cleanupDeviceRegistry
methods.description: Cleans up the device registry after each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the registry and disconnects the client after all tests.

methods.name: getHelper
methods.description: Provides access to the test helper.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Provides a CredentialsClient for a given tenant.
